calendar 2026."},{"doc_id":"5fda9710-6688-47f7-8594-9ad473d107d5","seq":2,"headings":["Northstar Credit Policy 2026","2. Effective period"],"text":"This policy is effective from 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31.
It replaces the previous credit policy in full for requests dated on or after
2026-01-01."},{"doc_id":"5fda9710-6688-47f7-8594-9ad473d107d5","seq":3,"headings":["Northstar Credit Policy 2026","3. Approval authority"],"text":"Authority applies to the new total credit limit requested.

- Accounts Receivable Specialists may approve credit limits up to and including $100,000.
- Credit limits greater than $100,000 and up to and including $500,000 require Finance Manager approval.
- Credit limits greater than $500,000 require Director of Finance approval."},{"doc_id":"5fda9710-6688-47f7-8594-9ad473d107d5","seq":4,"headings":["Northstar Credit Policy 2026","4. Concurrence"],"text":"- For Strategic accounts, credit limits greater than $500,000 also require VP Sales concurrence."},{"doc_id":"5fda9710-6688-47f7-8594-9ad473d107d5","seq":5,"headings":["Northstar Credit Policy 2026","5. Eligibility"],"text":"- Payment history: no invoice due in the 12 months before the request
  may have been paid more than 30 days after its due date, or be unpaid more than
  30 days after it.
- Maximum credit limit: $750,000 for Strategic accounts; $250,000 for Standard accounts. Account tiers are as recorded in Northstar CRM.
- A parent-company guarantee in force raises the maximum by the guaranteed amount, for the
  customer the guarantee names."},{"doc_id":"5fda9710-6688-47f7-8594-9ad473d107d5","seq":6,"headings":["Northstar Credit Policy 2026","6. Separation of duties"],"text":"- No one may approve or concur on a credit request they submitted. The approval or concurrence
  passes to the requestor's manager."},{"doc_id":"5fda9710-6688-47f7-8594-9ad473d107d5","seq":7,"headings":["Northstar Credit Policy 2026","7. Records"],"text":"- Credit decisions are recorded in Northstar ERP with the approver and, where required, the
  concurring approver."}],"total":7}

**4. Payment history: clean.** Late means paid, or still unpaid, more than 30 days after the due date, for invoices due in the 12 months before the request.
- INV-60412 was due 2025-11-28 and paid 2025-11-24.
- INV-62011 was due 2026-07-25 and paid 2026-07-22.
- INV-62305 ($720,000) was due 2026-10-02. That is after the request date, so it doesn't count.

A guarantee raises the cap only by its guaranteed amount, and only if it is in force and names this customer. To reach $1,000,000, Acme needs a guarantee of at least $250,000 naming Acme Mfg. Holdings (C-1001) and in force on 2026-09-23.

- Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive in Sales. She has no credit approval authority.

- Neither of them submitted the request, so the rule that no one may approve their own request doesn't change anything.
- If no guarantee can be shown, the most Acme can get is $750,000. That needs the same two people.
